· Above SMA100 ($254.55), above SMA200 ($238.74): mid-to-long-term trend strength maintained.
· 52-week position (71.5%) + current price level approximately 9% below 52-week high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (52.5 → 51.3) + neutral assessment + continued weakening momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.4718 → -1.0592) + slowing improvement diagnosis + no trend reversal signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $265.75) + band width at 9.68% level interpretation.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($255.19) + basis (20-day low, SMA50 based).
· Swing resistance ($274.75) + potential uptrend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (consolidation) + interpretation of lack of trend direction.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.43) + reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) + entry conditions unmet, maintaining a wait-and-see stance.
